scope: Targeted third pass on 50 fortified-region records and five infantry AA-marking records. Not a third pass of all remaining counters.
visual_review: All 50 original UR pairs and four prior retrieved candidates per profile reviewed on nine sheets; five AA pairs, 74 additional retrieval cells, manual full-sheet context on KIC108 pp1/3/5/7/9, 18 initial manual pair cards, 21 additional pair cards, closer native panels and rotated labels checked. Final 39 accepted UR pairs rechecked on seven final sheets. Retrieval scores only suggest locations; they are not confidence or proof.
resolved_final_qa: 52 infantry reverse AA 1 is visible in the enlarged final comparison. Its provisional uncertainty was resolved before saving. UR67 was also confirmed on final pairing review.
policy: VASSAL artwork remains the working reference. Greater-than-.95 metadata confidence and no unresolved completeness/identity/pairing issue required for Verified. Printed level alternates stay Other; no reduction inferred.
limitations: Nine UR pairs still not confidently located in this targeted search; not evidence of absence. UR21 and UR25 physical/digital candidates require clarification. No gameplay implementation or validation. Interactive editor testing pending.
checks: 55 final temporary editor save/reload checks; future fields, sentinel, backups, loaded statuses and completeness preserved. Live definitions unchanged during automated checks. No application code changed in this batch.
